## Components

### Button (Primary)

```ts
// PrimaryButton.tsx
import { StyleSheet, Pressable, Text } from 'react-native';
import { tokens } from './tokens';
import { useTheme } from './useTheme'; // returns tokens.color[colorScheme]

export function PrimaryButton({ label, onPress }: { label: string; onPress: () => void }) {
  const colors = useTheme();
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.base,
        { backgroundColor: pressed ? colors.accentStrong : colors.accent },
      ]}
      accessibilityRole="button"
    >
      <Text style={[styles.label, { color: colors.textInverse }]}>{label}</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    // Minimum 44pt touch target (iOS HIG) / 48dp (Android)
    minHeight: 48,
    paddingHorizontal: tokens.space['6'],   // 24
    paddingVertical: tokens.space['3'],     // 12
    borderRadius: tokens.radius.md,         // 12
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  label: {
    ...tokens.type.label,                   // fontSize 14, fontWeight '500'
  },
});
```

### Card

```ts
// Card.tsx
import { StyleSheet, View, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { tokens } from './tokens';
import { useTheme } from './useTheme';

export function Card({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const colors = useTheme();
  return (
    <View style={[
      styles.base,
      { backgroundColor: colors.surface, borderColor: colors.border },
      // Apply platform-correct shadow
      Platform.OS === 'ios' ? tokens.shadow.md.ios : tokens.shadow.md.android,
    ]}>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    borderRadius: tokens.radius.lg,         // 20
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    padding: tokens.space['4'],             // 16
  },
});
```

### Input

```ts
// TextInput.tsx
import { StyleSheet, TextInput as RNTextInput, View, Text } from 'react-native';
import { tokens } from './tokens';
import { useTheme } from './useTheme';

export function Input({ label, ...props }: RNTextInput['props'] & { label?: string }) {
  const colors = useTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.wrapper}>
      {label && (
        <Text style={[styles.label, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>{label}</Text>
      )}
      <RNTextInput
        style={[
          styles.input,
          {
            backgroundColor: colors.surfaceSubtle,
            borderColor: colors.border,
            color: colors.textPrimary,
          },
        ]}
        placeholderTextColor={colors.textTertiary}
        {...props}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    gap: tokens.space['1'],                 // 4 — requires RN >= 0.71
  },
  label: {
    ...tokens.type.caption,
  },
  input: {
    height: 48,                             // meets both iOS 44pt and Android 48dp minimum
    paddingHorizontal: tokens.space['3'],   // 12
    borderRadius: tokens.radius.md,         // 12
    borderWidth: 1,
    ...tokens.type.body,
  },
});
```

## Platform Notes

**Shadow**: iOS uses the `shadow*` style props (`shadowColor`, `shadowOffset`, `shadowOpacity`, `shadowRadius`). Android uses `elevation`. The shadow tokens above include both under `.ios` and `.android` keys — spread the correct one with `Platform.OS === 'ios' ? tokens.shadow.md.ios : tokens.shadow.md.android`.

**Font family**: the type tokens above omit `fontFamily` to use platform defaults (SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android). Add `fontFamily` only when loading a custom brand font via expo-font. Load fonts before the splash screen clears or text will flash the system font on first render.

**Safe areas**: use `useSafeAreaInsets()` from `react-native-safe-area-context` to add padding for notches, Dynamic Island, and the home indicator. Pair with `tokens.space` values — `insets.bottom + tokens.space['4']` for tab bar content padding is a common pattern. Never hardcode device-specific inset values.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- **Do** define all colors in the token system with explicit light and dark values. Call `useColorScheme()` once at the theme provider level, not scattered through components.
- **Do** use `StyleSheet.create` for all styles, including inside FlatList render functions. Object literals created inline allocate on every render.
- **Do** test at 2x font scale (iOS: Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Larger Text; Android: Settings > Display > Font size). Layouts that break at large text are accessibility failures.
- **Do** use `SafeAreaView` or `useSafeAreaInsets()` on every screen. Notches and home indicators vary by device; hardcoded insets break on new hardware.
- **Do** gate RN API usage on the detected `rnVersion`. Check for `gap` support (0.71+), New Architecture APIs (0.73+), and `Pressable` `aria-*` props (0.74+) before using them.
- **Do** respect `useReducedMotion()` — check it in every animated component and skip or replace animations when it returns true.

### Don't

- **Don't** use inline styles in FlatList `renderItem` or any component that renders more than a handful of times. `style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}` allocates a new object every render.
- **Don't** animate layout properties (`width`, `height`, `top`, `left`, `padding`, `margin`). These force layout recalculation on the JS thread. Use `transform` and `opacity` only.
- **Don't** hardcode colors as hex literals in component files. Every color must come from the token system so dark mode works without component-level changes.
- **Don't** reach for a Modal as the first answer to any secondary action. Exhaust stack push, inline expansion, swipe actions, and bottom sheet first.
- **Don't** use a bottom tab bar with more than five items. Beyond five, use a hamburger menu or a secondary navigation pattern — but question whether all those destinations are truly primary.
- **Don't** use pure `#000000` or `#ffffff`. Always tint toward the brand hue, even at near-black and near-white values. Pure black reads as harsh on OLED; pure white reads as clinical on both platforms.
